diagnostic_semantics: Strict clean/diagnostic semantic parity for FullKV, StepKV, LazyEviction and ThinkKV. ONLY async SideQuest may diverge; divergent question IDs/counts are explicitly reported.
scope: 24 unified ORIGINAL StepKV HF-decoder groups; common FullKV once per dataset. EOS/256-token cap THEN posthoc stop cropping; no separate engine controls. Free rollouts, not fixed-work kernel throughput.
pairing: Mean exactly two clean repeats per question, then bootstrap paired question differences. Diagnostics never enter clean CIs. Negative delta means faster.
